notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1
notes.content:
First update since release
Adjustments have been made to allow players to enjoy the original kiting action

■Game content changes
・Only 3 scarecrows are now available in Wave 1
・Enemies that survive for 10 seconds or more will be 1.5 times faster
■Title menu UI changes
・Added a button to the ranking page
・Added a button to the official SNS

notes.title: ExTermi now available!
notes.content:
Finally, the distribution of our first game "ExTermi" has started!
Thank you to everyone who played the game in Playtest and gave us feedback!

Dodge the enemy's onslaught and use your skills with split-second decisions——
An action shooter where speed and strategy intersect, and some players will somehow feel at home in it!

[h3]■ Features[/h3]

Intuitive MOBA-style controls make anyone feel at ease with the action!

Aim for a high score by linking skills!
A thrilling wave-based battle!

Your play will be the fuel for the next update!
Reviews and feedback are also very welcome.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/3456170/leaderboards/16330520/]You can also check the rankings here! [/url]
